items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Yeah but he just come back — he got us together in maybe a half hour. We were trying to play it, we couldn’t.

ctx.x: Can you think of when one of the hardest recordings you ever participated in? Would it have been some of the more modern stuff? Or don’t you even look at it that way?
You mean when I got tied up inside. Well there was a couple of times. With Stravinsky, forget about it.
Tell me about that, will you, the Stravinsky?
